text:
Alex Park: Heads-up — AWS listing team just asked for an artifact map for our security/compliance submission. They want SOC2 report, pen-test exec summary, questionnaire answers, and a redaction plan by next week. Link to request: https://aws.example.com/review/REQ-8892 :eyes:
Meera Singh: Can you paste the exact checklist snippet? I want to confirm file formats and presign requirements.
Alex Park: Copied from reviewer email: 
"Please provide: SOC2 Type II PDF, external penetration test summary (redacted), full pen-test with IP redactions via presigned S3 links, responses to vendor security questionnaire (PDF), and contact for any follow-ups. Max file size 250MB."
David Li: For the full pen-test we only have the original report with tester notes — will need redaction. Who owns redaction for infra diagrams and tester/employee names?
Eva Ruiz: I can take infra diagrams and host redacted versions. Will need a list of IPs/hostnames to remove or pseudonymize.
Chris Long: I'll prep the S3 prefix and presign URLs once artifacts are ready. Plan: create s3://redwood-marketplace-evidence/REQ-8892/{soc2,pen,questionnaire,redaction-manifest}/ and give 7-day presign.
Meera Singh: Good. Alex, can you confirm if legal wants a separate attestation PDF? Last listing required an attestation that redactions preserve meaning.
Alex Park: Legal asked for an attestation template last quarter — attaching: https://docs.internal/redwood/attestation-template.pdf (internal). They'll likely want signed PDF.
security-bot: Automated check: SOC2 certificate on record (2024-10-12) — format OK. External pen-test vendor: OptiSec. Contact: pencontact@optisec.example.com.
David Li: OptiSec gave us a full report plus raw pcap; we'll not share pcap. Need to redact tester signatures + internal IPs.
Eva Ruiz: Proposed redaction checklist: 1) Remove employee names 2) Replace internal hostnames with HOST-### 3) Strip raw logs/pcap 4) Keep findings and remediation text. I can produce both redacted and redaction-manifest (one-line mapping of removed items).
Meera Singh: Sounds good. Owners: SOC2 (Gina / compliance), Pen-test redaction (Eva), Uploads (Chris), Questionnaire answers (Alex). I'll be coordinator and do final bundle check.
Alex Park: Timeline: can we aim to have drafts by Tuesday 09:00 PT? Reviewer deadline is Thu EOD.
Chris Long: Upload steps I'll use (so infra knows):
```
# create folder
aws s3api put-object --bucket redwood-marketplace-evidence --key REQ-8892/
# set ACL and lifecycle
aws s3 cp ./SOC2.pdf s3://redwood-marketplace-evidence/REQ-8892/soc2/SOC2_2024.pdf --acl private
# generate presign
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-evidence/REQ-8892/soc2/SOC2_2024.pdf --expires-in 604800
```
Meera Singh: Also note: redaction needs review by security before upload. @security-bot can you add a checklist for review sign-off?
security-bot: Created review ticket SD-4123. Checklist items: verify no employee PII, confirm infra diagrams obfuscated, confirm no raw capture files included. Assignee: Eva Ruiz.
Eva Ruiz: I accepted SD-4123. I'll aim to deliver redacted pen-test + manifest by Monday EOD so Meera can review Tue morning.
David Li: Quick Q about questionnaire: do we include the raw Google Form responses or download as PDF? AWS asked for consolidated PDF.
Alex Park: Consolidated PDF please. I'll draft answers and ping product for any architecture clarifications.
Meera Singh: Risk notes: we may need to explain our key management (KMS) and presign handling for artifacts. Alex, please add a one-paragraph KMS note to the questionnaire.
Alex Park: Will do. Also tagging legal for the attestation: @legal-team (FYI).
partners-bot: Reminder: upload bucket retention policy is 90 days for marketplace artifacts. :information_source:
Chris Long: One more ops note — presigned links will be rotated after 7 days; if reviewer needs longer, we'll generate a new set and email them.
Meera Singh: OK owners/next steps roundup:
- Alex: questionnaire + attestation paragraph (due Mon 14:00 PT)
- Eva: redacted pen-test + manifest (due Mon EOD)
- Chris: S3 folder + presigns after security sign-off (due Tue morning)
- Gina (compliance): SOC2 PDF confirmation (please confirm availability)
- Meera: final bundle check and submit to reviewer (due Tue 12:00 PT)
Gina (via DM later): Confirmed — SOC2 PDF ready and I'll upload to shared drive for Alex to fetch.
Alex Park: Thanks everyone. If blockers pop up, call a quick sync. Otherwise I'll post a final submission message here when uploaded. :thumbsup:
